jobs.description:
Help shape the next chapter of hospitality technology.You build your own pipeline and know how to close a deal with five stakeholders and a procurement team. You will be selling to top-tier hotel brands around the world.

At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI.
We're now expanding beyond proposals into booking, workflows and AI-powered operations. As Senior Account Executive you'll own new business with hotel groups, luxury brands and management companies, from first outreach to signed contract. Our native two-way integration with OPERA Cloud gives you a strong story with the hotels that run it. You'll report to our Head of Sales. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.
Your mission:

Build your own pipeline through targeted outbound to hotel groups, chains and luxury brands. Expect around two-thirds of your closed deals to come from your own outreach.

Run 100+ targeted prospecting activities a week and keep 8–12 qualified opportunities moving at any time.

Own the full cycle from discovery and demo to business case, negotiation and close. Deals range from €50k to €300k ACV, with cycles of roughly four to eight months.

Multi-thread every deal across the 4–8 people involved, from C-level to GMs, Directors of Sales, Revenue, IT, Finance and Procurement.

Use a structured qualification method to keep your forecast accurate and your deals moving.

Work through security reviews, DPAs and RFPs together with our team.

Represent Proposales at industry events in Europe and our other key markets.

Share market and customer insights and learnings with product and marketing.

A bit about you:

5+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with at least 2 of those years on mid-market or enterprise accounts.

A track record of beating quota with pipeline you created yourself.

You've closed deals of €50k+ ACV with long cycles and several decision-makers and can walk us through how.

You're comfortable leading conversations with C-level executives and building a business case they sign off on.

You sell by a methodology (MEDDICC, Challenger, Command of the Message or similar) and can show us how you use it in a live deal.

You use AI daily for account research, call prep and follow-up.

Hospitality tech experience (PMS, sales & catering, CRM) or a background in hotel sales is a strong plus.

Fluent English. Another European language is a plus.

You live in Stockholm, or are ready to move here, and like working from an office with your team.

What we offer:
Real ownership. We’re expanding into new markets and beyond proposals, so you’ll help shape how we sell to enterprise, not just follow a playbook.

A proven product to sell. Proposales has been recognised as a leading RFP and proposal management solution five years in a row.

Short decision lines. You’ll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.

Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission on new ARR.

A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.

A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.

What we believe in:
We value ownership over process, curiosity over comfort and getting things done over getting them perfect.

Join our Stockholm team as an on-call Sales Associate! A flexible contract that fits perfectly around studies or other commitments. Shifts are based on business needs, especially during peak periods and for coverage.
MORE ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM
The new Sales Associate should be able to work as part of a team and provide an exceptional shopping experience while having a genuine interest in our Stockholm community and aiming to contribute to the teams overall performance and values.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Our Sales Associates are responsible for excellent customer service, increasing brand knowledge, executing visual standards and driving performance goals set for our store in cooperation with the Store Manager.
Key Responsibilities will include:

To develop and maintain good product knowledge and provide excellent customer service in line with the company’s expectations.

An understanding of current products, trends and collections and ensuring that customers are informed and aware.

To continuously build and maintain customer relationships-our customers are our community!

To replenish stock and maintain high standards of merchandise and product presentation.

To know your city and the social movements within it. To use this information as a tool during the customer service ceremony.

To be aware of daily sales targets and KPI goals, actively driving personal performance to support the store's business growth.

Work in and promote a team-oriented environment that can have fun whilst remaining professional.

ARE YOU THE ONE?
We seek people with most of the following: 

Great communication skills with a social personality; You enjoy meaningful conversations, listen actively and translate customer needs into memorable buying experiences.

Engage customers with genuine enthusiasm and pick up on details that let you tailor your approach to each customer.

Work well with others and are a strong team player.

Open to new things and receptive to constant development.

Self-motivated, can work productively and take initiative.

Value creativity, diversity and progress, and you thrive in a modern, purpose-driven environment

Passionate about Axel Arigato products and brand is a plus.

Prior sales experience in retail is preferred.

Sales experience with high-end retail brands is an advantage.

Willing to work flexible hours and availability as per business needs

HERE'S HOW TO APPLY
Apply by submitting your CV in English ASAP.
Our recruitment process is strictly based on competencies therefore, we kindly ask you not to include your picture or age with your application.
We process applications continuously and the position may be filled before the last day of application.  
Contract type: On-Call Estimated starting date: ASAP 
A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO Founded in Sweden in 2014, Axel Arigato is intrinsically grounded in culture, community, and craft. Driven by curiosity, the brand has consistently connected its approach to the rhythm of what is happening in the wider world, looking to an ever-evolving contemporary society for both purpose and inspiration. It presents diverse collections of elevated and wearable footwear and ready-to- wear, fusing together Scandinavian minimalism with unexpected, contemporary design.
The brand has nine physical stores in five countries, as well as a network of over 250 wholesale partners and retail concessions. Axel Arigato is committed to fostering connections beyond the conventions of commerce, and are a proud equal opportunity employer who values a diverse workforce. As such, its core mission remains true to this day: to build a positive platform through the power of community, inclusivity, and memorable experiences.
OUR VALUES : DROP Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our values that we live and breathe. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

Luleå University of Technology experiences rapid growth with world-leading expertise within several research areas. Our scientific and artistic research and education are conducted in close collaboration with international, national and regional companies, the public sector and leading universities. Luleå University of Technology has an annual turnover of just over SEK 2.3 billion. We have more than 1,800 employees and nearly 21,600 students.
The Machine Learning group at the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for experienced students from the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme for a project focusing student retention through the mentoring and support of first year students in the programme.
 
 
You will have the opportunity to work together with other mentors and keep in contact with some senior staff, while getting the opportunity to:
Meet new people and refresh information from earlier courses
Improve your communication- and social skills
Gain leadership/mentoring experience

Job Duties
 
Typical job duties for this position will focus on tasks related to leadership and mentoring:
Organizing regular meetings with the mentee-group assigned to you, where you discuss their current challenges and questions
Having some hours set aside on a weekly basis in case one of your mentees would like to have an individual meeting/discussion
Advising students on who they can help/advise them in certain situations (if you cannot do so yourself)
Keeping in regular touch both with the mentees and other mentors

Qualifications
 
To be eligible for the position, you must be enrolled as a student in the "Civilingenjör tillämpad Artificiell Intelligens" programme of LTU. You must be in at least your second year of study and have some experience in mentoring (e.g. having had earlier meetings with the 1st year students during the first study period of the year). You are also expected to be able to take your own initiative and work independently.
 
 
It is a merit to have contributed to the programme in some capacity before (e.g. as student representative, member in Programme Council, having a role in the program association).
 
 
Terms and conditions
 
Employment as a teaching assistant is governed by Chapter 5 of the Higher Education Ordinance. Only those admitted to first- or second-cycle studies may be employed as teaching assistants (Chapter 5, Section 10 of the Higher Education Ordinance).
 
 
Hourly pay/renumeration
 
All assignments provide hourly pay and valuable work experience for your CV. The hourly rate depends on the complexity of the duties:
Level 1: 156 kr/hour 
Level 2: 171 kr/hour  
 
 
Information
 
The position is 10% full-time, corresponding to an average of a half day/week over a period of 6 months from December 2026  to June 2027 or as agreed. The place of work is Luleå.
The workload may vary over time and by agreement. The goal is to distribute the work so that it is compatible with your studies.
 
 
For further information, please contact: György Kovács senior lecturer, gyorgy.kovacs@ltu.se

QA manager
For the Syntagon AB based in Södertälje, we are looking for a QA Manager
About us
Syntagon is a Swedish Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) based in Södertälje, with more than 25 years of experience in developing and manufacturing active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). We support pharmaceutical and biotech companies from early development and clinical phases through to commercial supply, with expertise in small molecules, peptides, purification and analytical services.
Originally founded in Södertälje in 1998, Syntagon became part of Ardena in 2018. In 2026, the business entered a new chapter when it was acquired by Nanologica and once again began operating as Syntagon. Today, we combine decades of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing experience with our culture built on scientific excellence, quality, collaboration and responsibility.
What you will work on
Your key responsibilities
The Quality Assurance group plays a pivotal role in ensuring that all our API development and manufacturing processes are executed according to GMP guidelines and to provide a development phase GMP support to the operational teams.
As a QA manager you provide leadership in ensuring continuous compliance with internal and external regulations, standards, policies and procedures related to the quality and performance of company operations.
Responsibilities
·        Approve raw material QC results, IPC results and CoA.
·        Approve Master Batch Production Records.
·        Approve executed batch records and cleaning records.
·        Release of raw materials, consumables and intermediates for manufacturing.
·        Release of APIs.
·        Ensure compliance with the established standards.
·        Approve deviations and CAPA.
·        Approve OOS.
·        Approve quality specifications and test methods.
·        Manage and perform GMP training for all staff.
·        Manage qualification of GMP-related service providers (contract QC labs and others).
·        Approve SOPs and Work Routines.
·        Issue new or updated SOP, Instructions, Work Routines.
·        Participate in and conduct internal quality audits.
·        Participate in client audits and authority inspections.
·        Issue and approve validation/qualification protocol and reports.
 
Your profile looks like /resembles
·        You have a MSc or PhD degree within the science/technology field, preferably chemistry, biotechnology, pharmacy or equivalent.
·        Experience and knowledge of GMP quality system 
·        Knowledge of EU & FDA guidelines and regulatory agencies expectations.
·        Minimum of 3 years of GMP experience and minimum 1 year of QA experience in a CDMO company.
·        You are solution driven, keeping timelines in mind.
·        You are continuously looking for improvement.
·        You have strong communication skills, able to listen and analyze a quality issue and explain the proposed solution in an accurate manner.
·        You are flexible, a problem solver and a team player.
·        You have an analytical mindset and you are comfortable in stressful situations.
·        You are fluent in English.
 
 
·        Experience from APIs and drug products intended for clinical trials is strongly meriting.
·        Experience with relevant digital systems and software is highly desirable, including:
-Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365
-SciLife
-Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
-DocuSign
-Chromeleon
 
WHAT WE OFFER
·        A true learning environment where you will have the ability to grow your skills.
·        A dynamic working environment with nice colleagues.
·        Open straightforward but also caring culture.
·        Generous wellness allowance.
·        An attractive remuneration package.
·        Flexible working hours.

At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow! 
UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL  
At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow.  Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/  
ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS INTERFACE ENGINEER 
Join Us in Shaping the Future of Large-Scale Laundry Solutions! 
We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Interface Engineer who thrives where hardware, software, and electrical systems come together. You bring a curious mindset, enjoy solving cross-functional challenges, and are eager to contribute to technical decisions that shape future products.  
With us, you will work with innovation and future-oriented large-scale laundry machines! 
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING  
We want to focus on future product features 3–5 years ahead, which is why we have chosen to expand the team with an additional colleague. In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence technical decisions at an early stage, help shape the products of the future and most importantly work with innovation rather than purely maintenance and sustainment tasks. 
Your responsibilities will include: 
Act as a technical bridge between electrical design and electronics. 
Contribute to long-term technical strategy and future product features. 
Understand and contribute to PCB development, including both hardware and software aspects. 
Maintain technical documentation and ensure that design data, drawings, specifications, and revisions are correctly managed and released according to established processes in PDM systems. 
Participate in the development of specifications for electronic control boards. 
Ensure seamless interaction between electrical systems, electronics, and control systems. 
Take part in testing, analysis, and further development of solutions. 

WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE 
We believe you are relatively early in your career but already demonstrate a strong technical drive and ability to take ownership. You enjoy working where hardware, software, and electrical systems meet, and you are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with experienced colleagues. 
Qualification: 
A few years of experience working at the interface between electrical systems, electronics, software, or embedded systems 
Solid understanding of PCB development, control boards, and control systems 
Comfortable working across both hardware and software domains, with the ability to understand how the two interact in a complete product 
An eagerness to learn and grow technically, combined with a senior mindset and the confidence to challenge solutions and contribute to technical discussions 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multiple engineering disciplines 
Knowledge of EMC, electrical safety, and relevant standards is considered a merit 
Analytical, communicative, and solution-oriented mindset 
Master’s degree in ex. Electrical Engineering /Electronics/Embedded Systems, Mechatronics/Engineering Physics/Mechanical Engineering.  

You will be part of a team with high technical seniority and strong team spirit. The team is international, and therefore English is the primary working language. Knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit. 
To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.
OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES  
Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably.  
We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help. 
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 
Trust, ownership, and the opportunity to grow! Be part of a company grounded in customer focus, sustainability leadership, innovation, and social impact.  
We aim to Meet Needs Beyond Tomorrow! 
Some of our benefits:  
Occupational pension plan 
Collective agreement 
Lunch benefits 
Massage at the office at discounted price 
 Wellness allowance 
Beniflex (discounts on purchases) 
Parental leave benefits 

Note that benefits can vary based on location.

Window Cleaner for Stockholm from March 2027
Job description
As a window cleaner at BVTLER, you will work on various assignments, including regular window cleaning, as well as cleaning of glazed balconies or other glass surfaces. Larger assignments for corporate clients may also occur. You will have the opportunity to work both independently and in a team. An important aspect of the job is delivering service of the highest quality and going the extra mile for your customers. The work is scheduled during flexible hours, Monday - Friday, between 7 am and 6 pm, but evening and weekend work may occur.
Your Profile
To thrive in the role of a window cleaner, you should be self-reliant, service-oriented, and flexible. Attention to detail, punctuality, and the ability to go the extra mile for your customers are essential. You need to be able to follow instructions and maintain a positive attitude.
We are looking for someone who:

Has basic knowledge of Swedish or English in both speech and writing

Has at least 1 years of experience in window cleaning

Can work flexible working hours from 7 am to 6pm

Experience in high-altitude window cleaing (crane/harness) is a plus, but not required

We offer you
BVTLER is a positive workplace with a focus on its employees. Here, you will have the opportunity to work with fantastic colleagues from various parts of the world and continue to develop in your professional role.
As a window cleaner at BVTLER, you will receive:

Collective agreement

Occupational pension

Wellness grant

Paid travel time between customers

Opportunity for a company car

 
The employment starts with a 6-month probationary period.
Location: Stockholm  Start: Interviews and recruitment are ongoing
You are warmly welcome to submit your application today!

On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for an Investment Controller Capital Projects. You see finance as both a decision and control function, combining accuracy with the curiosity to turn numbers into action.
The partner is strengthening its capability in investment control for technology facilities and capacity programmes. You will connect capital expenditure, business cases and project follow-up while ensuring that depreciation and scenarios receive appropriate discipline. The aim is practical progress that colleagues can use, leaders can evaluate and the organisation can sustain.
Finance values dependable reporting, strong controls and constructive partnership. Success means better decisions and trusted information.
How you will work
You will work with finance colleagues, operational leaders and system owners. The partner values early escalation, transparent assumptions and lasting improvements.
This role calls for independent judgement and the ability to raise the quality around you. You are expected to make trade-offs visible, recognise when a decision needs wider expertise and move work forward without creating unnecessary process.
What you will do
Own the practical direction for investment control for technology facilities and capacity programmes.
Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for capital expenditure and business cases.
Establish useful standards, routines or decision artefacts around project follow-up.
Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting depreciation.
Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve scenarios.
Strengthen knowledge sharing and sustainable ownership through steering committees.
What you will bring
Relevant experience delivering investment control for technology facilities and capacity programmes in a demanding environment.
Strong working knowledge of capital expenditure and business cases.
Practical experience applying project follow-up and depreciation.
Ability to assess priorities, risks and trade-offs involving scenarios.
Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership.
Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information.
Experience that would add value
Experience from manufacturing energy and corporate investment.
Exposure to steering committees in a cross-functional or multi-team environment.
Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations.
A background that can succeed here
Your background may be group finance, operations, audit, advisory or a growing business. Show the controls and decisions you owned and the outcome. Direct experience of investment control for technology facilities and capacity programmes is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement.
What makes the opportunity interesting
The role combines professional depth with meaningful business questions and room to improve the processes behind the numbers. The focus on investment control for technology facilities and capacity programmes gives the opportunity a clear mission and room to influence priorities and success measures.
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision.
The recruitment conversation
Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to ask direct questions and test whether the role, mandate and partner environment are right for you.
How to apply
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant financial process, decision or transformation you helped improve. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside formal titles.
